notes: The previous-day change may include position transfers in or out.
Month to date excludes deposits and withdrawals, simple method.
card.subtitle: Two accounts total · data day 10-21

cash.explain: Sum of member cash (broker TotalCashValue, USD). Large figure: cash share of net value; small: amount. Needs same-day cash, net value and countries. Negative cash is a Margin loan, shown On margin.
cash.label: Cash

day_change.explain: Flex daily total of the latest report day minus the previous one, summed over members, USD. Includes deposits, withdrawals and transfers, not pure return. Percentage is over the prior US day total.
day_change.label: Previous trading day

month_to_date.explain: Month change (month-end total minus month-start total minus deposits, USD) over the month-start total, simple method, not time-weighted. The month starts on 2026-10-01. Deposit timing is ignored.
month_to_date.label: Month to date (excl. deposits and withdrawals)

net_worth.explain: Sum of member net liquidation values (broker NetLiquidation, USD), latest after-close snapshot; hidden if a member has none or times are too far apart. Non-USD stocks (JPY) use broker rates, hence ≈.
net_worth.label: Net value
